decisionsTitle: «Planul voluntarilor»: «Poze și hărți» at the top — several pictures and links — and «Fără punct» a fold you place people from
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, from the phone, with a screenshot of «Fără punct» on «Planul voluntarilor»:** «aici eu vreau sa pot asigna voluntari la punct direct de aici: Si sectiunea trebuie sa fie collapsible. Poza okanului [planului] trebuie sa fie mai sus, si sa pot pune mai multe poze, si link-uri, am facut spre exemplu un google maps custom map si vreau sa pot pune url-ul».

Two asks about the same page (`/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari`, §949, §952, §956, §961, §974): place a person from the list of people at no point, with that list folded like the rest of the page; and move the plan's picture up, let it be several pictures, and let it hold links — the owner's own Google My Maps map.

**Decision — «Fără punct» (amends §949 and §974).**

- «Fără punct» becomes a fold like the page's others (`details`, the page's `foldBar`, `BOXED_DISCLOSURE_SX`; id `plan-unplaced`), last in both views as before. Its closed line says how many stand at no point («2 voluntari», «niciun voluntar»: the counted phrases the page already has). Closed by default, as every fold of the page (§974), and open after a press made in it (`saved=planUnplaced`). On paper it prints open, its arrow off, as the groups and points do (`OPEN_ON_PAPER`); its empty states stay.
- On each person's line, while the plan has at least one point, one small form, never on paper: a native select of the plan's points — required, an empty first choice «Alege punctul», an `optgroup` «Pe traseu» with each route point as «{number}. {name} · km {km}» in the plan's one order (`listPlanPoints`, §961), then an `optgroup` «La start–finish» by name, a group with no point left out — and «Pune», 44 pixels, named for the person. The native select is «Pune aici»'s own pattern: it works without scripts and opens as the phone's own list. The form posts the existing `placeVolunteerAction` with the person and `at=unplaced`; the service, its lock, its audit and its refusals are «Pune aici»'s, unchanged.
- A press from «Fără punct» comes back to `?view=…&saved=planUnplaced#plan-unplaced` — the fold open, the next person one press away; a refusal to the page's alert, as every press of the page (§953). «Pune aici» and «Scoate» are unchanged.
- The help says both ways, short: «Încă nu stau la niciun punct. Alege-le punctul aici, pe rândul fiecăruia, sau cu „Pune aici” la punct.»

**Decision — «Poze și hărți» (amends §952: one picture becomes a list, plus links; amends §974: the fold first and open when it holds something).**

- **Data, expand only (migration `0213`).** Two tables, in `src/db/schema/volunteer-plan.ts` (it imports `events.ts` and `gallery.ts`; neither imports it, so these have the real foreign keys the column of §952 could not): `event_volunteer_plan_pictures` — an event (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), a stored picture (`media_assets`, cascading as a gallery item does), a position from 1, once per plan (unique event and picture); and `event_volunteer_plan_links` — an event (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), an address of at most 2 000 characters, an optional label of at most 120, a position from 1. The migration copies each event's one picture of §952 in at position 1 — only an id naming a stored picture that is no film poster — so no plan loses its picture.
- **The column of §952 stays, for a later contract.** `events.volunteer_plan_media_asset_id` is written by nobody and read by nobody but `media/references.ts`, which keeps counting it so nothing it names is swept before the contract; the events' blank row keeps naming it. Dropping it is a later contract release, after this one is in production.
- **Who.** Whoever works the volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer and the Administrators), asked at each action's door (`requireStaffCapability`) and again in each service before anything is read (BR-REQ-060-01); anybody else refused (FORBIDDEN) with nothing written.
- **Pictures.** «Adaugă o poză» — the backoffice's one upload, the existing island, now always appending (its «Schimbă poza» wording goes) — puts the stored picture last (the greatest position plus one); the id must name a stored picture that is no film's poster (VALIDATION_ERROR naming `assetId`); one already on this plan changes nothing; a thirteenth is refused (`PLAN_PICTURES_FULL`, a sentence with `{max}`). «Șterge poza» under each picture, which asks, removes that row; the stored picture is not deleted (the sweep's, §73). Each press under the event row's lock (`for("no key update")`, as the plan's other presses), the event's `version` unmoved, one audit row a change: `event.volunteer_plan_picture_added` / `event.volunteer_plan_picture_removed` with the stored picture's id alone.
- **Links.** «Adaugă linkul» takes an address — trimmed, required, at most 2 000 characters, written whole (`https://` or `http://` and a host), read by `new URL()`, `https:` or `http:` only (never `javascript:`, `data:`, `mailto:` or a file), no space or control character — else refused naming its box (`PLAN_LINK_URL`: «Scrie adresa întreagă, care începe cu https://.»); a label, optional, trimmed, at most 120 characters (`PLAN_LINK_LABEL`), empty meaning none, one label for both languages as a plan point's name is; a thirteenth link is refused (`PLAN_LINKS_FULL`). The same address already on the plan changes nothing, so a second press of a slow form adds no twin. A kept form (`ActionForm`): a refusal names its box and keeps what was typed (§315). «Șterge linkul», which asks naming the link, removes it. Audit `event.volunteer_plan_link_added` / `event.volunteer_plan_link_removed` with the link's id alone — never the address or the label.
- **The page.** «Poze și hărți» (glyph `pictures`) is the first fold, right under the intro and above the views' tabs, in both views; it is open whenever it holds a picture or a link (the owner wants the map high and in sight), closed while empty, and open after a press in it (`saved=planMaps`). Its closed line counts both («2 poze · 1 link», «nicio poză · niciun link»: counted phrases, `countForm`). The pictures stand in a grid (`repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr))`: two or three a row on a laptop, one on a phone), each at its display size with its `srcset`, at most 360 pixels tall on the screen (`object-fit: contain`), a press opening the whole in a new tab; the hint once under the grid. The links are a list: each its label in bold — or, with none, its host without `www.` and the start of its path — opening in a new tab (`rel="noopener noreferrer"`), 44 pixels tall, its host after it in grey. With no store the upload is replaced by the sentence that says so; links still work.
- **On paper the plan prints as before.** The view's plan stays the first thing after the title (§974): the fold carries `order: 1` on paper inside the page's flex column, so it prints after «Fără punct» — each picture one piece on a sheet (at most 17 cm), each link its label and its whole address as text; the fold's bar, the hint and every control are off the sheet, and an empty fold prints nothing.
- **The email «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui» (§956)** carries every picture of the plan in its order — the first half each picture with its open-it link (numbered when there are several), the second half the links alone, as before — and after them the plan's links as a short list (label or host, linked; the plain-text half writes the addresses), all read at the send through `readVolunteerPlanMaps`, which replaces the one picture's reader. The question before the press says the pictures and links go with it when the plan has any. The preview's made-up point carries one picture and one link.
- **Nothing public.** No public query, cache, page, series scope, repeat, duplicate, event file or import carries the new tables; deleting an event deletes their rows. `media/references.ts` counts the pictures' table in both places it counts the column — the in-use predicate and the pictures page's «Planul voluntarilor: {title}» line — so neither the sweep nor the pictures page's delete takes a plan's picture. `tests/unit/volunteers/plan-picture-never-leaves.test.ts` holds the structural guard: no file outside a reviewed list names the tables or the column.

**Left out, on purpose.**

- **Reordering.** A picture or a link is appended; to move one, remove it and add it again. Twelve of each is a short list, and drag-and-drop would be the page's first client island for order.
- **An embedded map.** A link opens in a new tab. Showing Google My Maps inside the page would need an iframe and the content-security policy opened to Google's hosts — a third party loaded into the backoffice for every reader — for what one press already gives.
- **Captions on pictures, and one label per language.** A link's label is one string for both languages, as a plan point's name is (§961); a picture has none.
- **Dropping `events.volunteer_plan_media_asset_id`.** Expand only here; the contract is a later release.
changelogLine: - **«Planul voluntarilor»: «Poze și hărți» first, and «Fără punct» you place people from** — the plan's map is now several pictures and links (a Google My Maps address, for instance) in the page's first fold, open when it holds something and printed after the plan; «Fără punct» folds, and each person in it gets the plan's points in a list and «Pune»; «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui» sends every picture and link. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 234 and 236 (one picture becomes a list, plus links). Given an event, then a staff member who works the volunteers may add up to twelve stored pictures and twelve links to its «Planul voluntarilor» («Poze și hărți»: `event_volunteer_plan_pictures` and `event_volunteer_plan_links`, migration `0213`, expand only, each cascading from the event; the migration copies each event's one picture of the release before — a stored picture that is no film's poster — in at position 1, and `events.volunteer_plan_media_asset_id` stays, written by nobody, until a later contract), each new one last, and take one off: a picture must be a stored picture that is no film's poster (VALIDATION_ERROR, `assetId`) and is once a plan (the same again changes nothing); a link's address must be an `https:` or `http:` address written whole, at most 2 000 characters (`PLAN_LINK_URL`), its label at most 120 (`PLAN_LINK_LABEL`) or none, and the same address again changes nothing; a thirteenth of either is refused (`PLAN_PICTURES_FULL`, `PLAN_LINKS_FULL`), each with its sentence; each change is one audit row naming the event and the picture's or the link's id alone (`event.volunteer_plan_picture_added`/`_removed`, `event.volunteer_plan_link_added`/`_removed`); the event's version does not move; no public query, series edit, repeat, duplicate, event file or import carries them (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 235, 274 and 275 (the plan's picture on the page). Given `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari`, then «Poze și hărți» / "Pictures and maps" is the first fold of the page in both views — under the intro, above the views' links —, open whenever it holds a picture or a link, closed while empty, and open after a press in it (`saved=planMaps`), its closed line counting both («2 poze · 1 link», «nicio poză · niciun link»); the pictures stand in a grid of cells at least 260 pixels wide, each at most 360 pixels tall, a press opening the whole of it in a new tab, «Șterge poza» under each (which asks) and «Adaugă o poză», which appends; the links each in bold — the label, or the host and the start of the path —, opening in a new tab, 44 pixels tall, the host in grey, «Șterge linkul» beside each (which asks, naming it) and «Adaugă linkul», a kept form that names the refused box and keeps what was typed. On paper the view's plan is still first: the fold prints after «Fără punct», each picture in one piece at most 17 cm tall and each link its label and its whole address, its bar and every control left off, and nothing for an empty fold. Verification: e2e `volunteer-plan-mail.spec.ts` (`emulateMedia` print) (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 229 and 274 («Fără punct»). Given `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari`, then «Fără punct» / "At no point" is a fold (`#plan-unplaced`), last in both views, closed unless the last press was made in it (`saved=planUnplaced`), its closed line how many stand at no point, printed open with its arrow off; while the plan has a point, each person's line carries a form never printed — a required native select of the plan's points, «Alege punctul» first, «Pe traseu» with each route point as «{number}. {name} · km {km}» in the plan's one order, then «La start–finish» by name, a group with no point left out — and «Pune» / "Put", named for the person, which posts `placeVolunteerAction` with the person and `at=unplaced` and comes back to «Fără punct», open; a refusal comes back to the page's alert; «Pune aici» and «Scoate» are unchanged (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 200. Given «Poze și hărți» on «Planul voluntarilor», then adding and taking off a picture or a link is asserted on the server twice: `addPlanPictureAction`, `removePlanPictureAction`, `addPlanLinkAction` and `removePlanLinkAction` ask `canManageVolunteers` at their own door, and the plan's services ask it again before the event, a picture or a link is read — so the Tehnic role, the Redactor, a desk Volunteer and a member are refused (FORBIDDEN) with nothing written, at the action without the service being reached; and `tests/unit/volunteers/plan-picture-never-leaves.test.ts` holds the files that may name the two tables — the schema, the plan and the reference check — and the retired column (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 93 in what the message carries of the plan. Given a `VOLUNTEER_POINT`, then it carries every picture of the plan in the plan's order — each drawn once in the first half inside a link to the whole of it, each link in words in both halves (numbered «poza 2 din 3» when there are several) and each address in the text half — and after them the plan's links, each its label or its host, linked, in both halves, with the addresses in the text half; all read as the message leaves, so a picture or a link taken off since is not sent; the question before the press says the pictures and links go with it when the plan has any, and the preview on `/admin/emails` shows one made-up picture and one made-up link (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 27. Given a stored picture on any event's «Poze și hărți» — or still named by the retired column of the release before —, when the orphan sweep runs or the pictures page's delete is pressed, then the picture is kept and the delete is refused, and the pictures page lists it once as used by that event's plan («Planul voluntarilor: {title}»); once every plan lets go of it, the sweep deletes it after its seven days (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari` on a 320-pixel screen and on a desktop, then «Pune» on a person's line of «Fără punct», the select beside it, each link of «Poze și hărți», «Adaugă linkul» and «Șterge linkul» are each at least 44 pixels tall, and nothing of the page is wider than the screen with those folds open (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Poze și hărți» — several pictures and links at the top of the volunteers' plan — and «Fără punct» a fold you place people from
